conditions: Studio session 23f85aed, build c30c4fe, single client, StudioDeviceSimulatorService hd_720 -> 1279x720, UIScale 1. Windows 11 host; Studio editor client, not a phone. Studio was brought to the foreground before sampling; it was not continuously verified to stay uncovered for the whole run. Default Studio graphics quality (not changed). Progressed fixture state: 30-80 owned copies across 5 collections, 6/6 Display occupied, 1 occupied plot. Sampler: module-owned Heartbeat accumulator, 10 s windows (FPS = frames/sum(dt), p95/max frame time, Stats:GetTotalMemoryUsageMb, Stats.InstanceCount, PlayerGui descendants).

menu_repetition.procedure: 3 warm-up cycles then 10 measured cycles of Y + R1 x4 + Y through all five dock screens; 20 s idle; counts taken with every screen closed.

repeated_openings.procedure: 3 paid Open 10 (Open, first reveal, View all results, Done), 15 s settle; then 2 more Pocket Grove batches with no new figure types.
repeated_openings.interpretation: +31 GUI descendants after the first three batches match pooled picker/Collection tiles for newly owned figure types; no further growth when no new types were added.

maxFrameMs.note: two windows at ~921-931 s contained 267 ms and 140 ms frames; all other windows <= 32 ms

memoryMb.note: dropped ~300 MB at ~410 s and ~100 MB at ~770 s, then flat 2,328-2,350

not_measured: Low/high graphics (would change the user's quality setting), eight occupied plots, full Shelves, network metrics, engine-wide connection/task counts (not enumerable from scripts), physical hardware.
earlier_samples_note: Idle-world windows before the warm-up (t=10-100 s) show GUI 3,267-4,286 and instances 57,799-58,863 while the progressed state was being built (openings, Equip Best, unlocks).
